title: Slovakian Oat Bowl
description: A hearty, comforting Slovakian-inspired oat bowl featuring kissed roasted oats and topped with a variety of delicious ingredients.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add 1 cup of rolled oats and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in 2 tbsp of kissed sugar until dissolved.
In a separate bowl, whisk together 1 cup of Slovakian vanilla yogurt and 1 tsp of honey.
Top the oat mixture with the yogurt mixture, roasted almonds, sliced strawberries, and chopped fresh mint.
Serve warm or chilled, depending on your preference.
